```python
def spread(values):
    """Return the mean absolute deviation of the values around their mean, ignoring missing values."""
    mean = values.mean()
    abs_deviations = np.abs(values - mean)
    mad = abs_deviations.mean()
    return mad
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def parse_signup_dates(texts):
    """Parse sign-up dates typed in by users; some are day-month-year, some year-month-day."""
    # Define the date formats to try
    date_formats = ["%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"]
    
    # Attempt to parse each text using the defined date formats
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(texts, format=date_formats, errors='coerce')
    
    # Return the parsed dates
    return parsed_dates
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def parse_signup_dates(texts):
    """Parse sign-up dates typed in by users; some are day-month-year, some year-month-day."""
    # Define the date formats to try
    date_formats = ["%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"]
    
    # Attempt to parse each text using the defined date formats
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(texts, format=date_formats, errors='coerce')
    
    # Check if any parsing was successful
    if parsed_dates.isnull().all():
        raise ValueError("No valid date format found for all inputs.")
    
    return parsed_dates
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def parse_signup_dates(texts):
    """Parse sign-up dates typed in by users; some are day-month-year, some year-month-day."""
    # Define the date formats that might be used
    date_formats = ["%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"]
    
    # Attempt to parse each text using the defined date formats
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(texts, format=date_formats, errors='coerce')
    
    # Check if any parsing was successful and raise an error if none were
    if parsed_dates.isnull().all():
        raise ValueError("None of the provided date formats matched the input texts.")
    
    return parsed_dates
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def parse_signup_dates(texts):
    """Parse sign-up dates typed in by users; some are day-month-year, some year-month-day."""
    # Define the date formats to try
    date_formats = ["%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"]
    
    # Use pd.to_datetime with errors='coerce' to handle parsing errors gracefully
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(texts, format=date_formats[0], errors='coerce')
    
    # If the first format fails, try the second format
    if parsed_dates.isnull().all():
        parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(texts, format=date_formats[1], errors='coerce')
    
    return parsed_dates
```

```python
import numpy as np
```

```python
def joint_density(x, y, bins):
    """Return the 2-D histogram of x and y, normalised so that its integral is 1, and the bin edges."""
    hist, xedges, yedges = np.histogram2d(x, y, bins=bins)
    density = hist / np.sum(hist)
    return density, xedges, yedges
```
